brief.objective: Deliver the authorized P0 compute-only split of immutable R while preserving the frozen interface, storage capacity and cycle behavior.
deliverables: rtl.snapshot@1 containing rtl/lb_feedback.sv with wire-only lb_feedback, lb_l0 and lb_l1; system instances named L0 and L1.
docs/implementation/physical-change.md documenting storage ownership, the compute cut and actual endpoint cells.
responsibilities: Read complete input manifests, detailed design, CSIR, spec/folding-spec.json and spec/contract.md; verify revision consistency and report conflicting authorities without choosing silently.

Keep PHY ports, mapping/configuration, request/response state, four weight rows, input/output banks and job/consume control in L0; keep all original non-PHY package ports, 32 signed8x8 products, eight tile reductions and eight signed32 accumulators in L1.
Route every host signal through L1 using reverse-direction link_<original_name> ports, including clock/reset; retain original host names on L0.
Preserve exactly fold_x[31:0], fold_w[255:0], fold_start, fold_consume and fold_next[255:0] as the compute cut, with specified start/consume behavior and combinational accumulator-plus-tile results.

Preserve 352 payload bytes, synchronous reset, last-tile errors, independent response delays, repair and backpressure; provide real retained TX buf_4/RX buf_2 endpoints on all 725 functional links, including clock/reset.
Use simulation-only library behavior under `ifndef SYNTHESIS; run quick lint/elaboration and publish through the exact native output protocol within the three-RTL-attempt authorization.
exclusions: Do not modify frozen specifications, checkers, tools or vendor IP; add wrapper state, another block, pipelines, serialization or fewer MACs.
Do not execute independent numerical, performance or physical qualification, or begin P1/P2 without subsequent user resume and captured physical feedback.
completion_criteria: The frozen P0 topology, ownership, links, arithmetic and external behavior are implemented with clean available lint/elaboration evidence.
Hard gates synthesizable-rtl-present and split-rationale pass at their declared paths.
Publish the declared rtl output only within its existing output and write boundaries.
collaboration: task:logic-folding-round1:full-design-integration receives the immutable P0 snapshot and split rationale.
Functional feedback repairs remain within the fixed P0 split; physical feedback permits later candidates only when the existing feedback_resume_authorized condition is true.

brief.objective: Deliver a reproducible integrated P0 top preserving the released component snapshot and frozen technology boundaries.
deliverables: rtl.integration@1 containing required integration wiring, address map, compile-order filelist and integration/dependencies.lock.json.
Lint, elaboration and bounded smoke-test evidence under reports/integration/**.
responsibilities: Consume the declared design, specification, constraints and RTL inputs without changing their semantics or component set.
Lock exact consumed sources and technology views, platform, corner and installation using the prescribed dependency-manifest schema; honor explicit allow_flop_memory=true.
Establish reproducible simulation and synthesis elaboration with the specified endpoint-cell models and real technology definitions.
Complete the role-required smoke coverage applicable to the frozen interface within 20 directed transactions; document inapplicable address or byte-mask cases without inventing interfaces.
exclusions: Do not redesign the P0 split, modify immutable RTL snapshots or vendor assets, introduce external IP, or write outside the existing integration permissions.
completion_criteria: The four declared integration results are complete: wiring, reproducibility manifests, clean lint/elaboration and bounded smoke evidence.
Publish the integration output through the fixed integrate executor with existing dependencies, permissions and output paths unchanged.
collaboration: task:logic-folding-round1:rtl-implementation supplies the component snapshot and resolves component-owned questions.
task:logic-folding-round1:functional-performance-verify receives the sole integrated DUT snapshot.

brief.objective: Independently establish P0 functional correctness, acceptance coverage and cycle performance against the frozen integrated DUT.
deliverables: environment: verification.environment@3 describing maintainable verification sources and compatibility.
report: verification.report@3 with acceptance traceability, reproducible commands, direct evidence, performance results and reports/verification/result_summary.json.
The required NEBULA_OUTPUT environment/report object and identical structured payload at reports/verification/report.json.
responsibilities: Use the declared specification and acceptance plan as oracle and rtl.integration as the only DUT; preserve frozen checker and acceptance-source integrity.

Cover all eight acceptance requirements, including all 65,536 configuration encodings, 73 legal maps, five seeds of 1,000 tasks, signed arithmetic, capacity, reset, overlap, backpressure and error behavior.

Measure all 162 frozen workloads: steady DRAM supply and completion intervals must not increase against the accepted reference; report added latency separately under the folding-specific supersession.
Deliver a minimal consolidated regression and distinct test-count, acceptance and coverage measurements, with evidence scope and reasons for unmeasured metrics.
Keep backend obligations explicitly deferred with responsible stages; distinguish pre-synthesis passage from complete physical acceptance.
exclusions: Do not modify the DUT, frozen checker/specification or add unrelated interface requirements; do not count deferred physical obligations as passed.
completion_criteria: Every acceptance point has a supported stage verdict and directly inspectable evidence; passed reports include the required evidence-manifest digest and non-empty shell-command strings.
verification-result-summary passes with all declared metrics and measured test/acceptance counts.
engineering-verdict passes against reports/verification/report.json without failed or unsupported requirements/checks.
Publish both declared outputs within existing write permissions through the fixed verify executor.
collaboration: task:logic-folding-round1:full-design-integration supplies the immutable integrated DUT.

task:logic-folding-round1:synthesize receives the verification report required by its passed-verdict release.
task:logic-folding-round1:independent-acceptance receives the acceptance and performance evidence.

reports/synthesis/memory_mapping.json and a complete synthesis-warning disposition.
responsibilities: Require the released verification report to have verdict=passed before synthesizing the declared integrated snapshot.
Apply frozen Sky130HD TT25C/1.8V, 100ns and declared I/O constraints; retain real endpoint cells and valid clock/reset connectivity.
Report both physical tops, their total cell area and minimum setup slack; distinguish Liberty cell area from LEF footprint and describe timing conditions.
Account for every RTL memory's capacity, ports, timing and implementation under explicit allow_flop_memory=true; preserve all storage and arithmetic resources.
Report required setup/hold metrics honestly, keeping final joint setup/hold qualification separate.
exclusions: Do not alter frozen RTL, verification conclusions or timing thresholds; do not publish a netlist with known negative gated setup slack or claim final physical qualification.
completion_criteria: synthesis-result-summary passes with every required metric and measured cell count, cell area and macro count.
setup-timing-closure passes with timing.setup_slack >= 0 in reports/synthesis/result_summary.json.
The declared netlist output contains reproducible evidence for both physical tops and remains within existing permissions.
